lighting.boundary: Physical Nishita / Multiple Scattering sky with a single solar disc at the actual source sun direction, no additional SUN to double its energy
lighting.surfaceEmission: Exported emission on actual fixture geometry retained; native leaf ambient emission suppressed as a declared thin-leaf adaptation

geometry: Exact exported source positions, indices, normals, UV, instance matrices and colors. Orthogonal TRS linked; affine shear and singular transforms baked without changing source triangle count. No new water or substitute garden/architecture mesh.

materialPorts.portablePBR: Preserve source base color, source and instance color multiplication, metric UV/texture transforms, roughness/metalness maps, normal XY scale, bump, coat and emissive fixtures
materialPorts.leafAndPetal: Same blades and original mapped color; energy-conserving Principled/Translucent mixture replaces native view-dependent added radiance. Not GLSL pixel parity.
materialPorts.water: Only retained actual Reflector geometry/matrix, if available from the official export. Dielectric IOR1.333, roughness0.07, dark green body, original six world-space wave functions as bump; actual path-traced scene/sky reflection, no photograph or reflected-scene proxy.
materialPorts.waterfall: Actual exported ribbon geometry, source color and UV; declared transmissive coverage approximation for nonportable dynamic alpha/foam hook.
materialPorts.sky: Native generated-LDR sky shader is not imported. Source-aligned physical atmosphere is an independent boundary approximation.
materialPorts.otherGLSL: World-space wood/rock/bark/granite color and micro-normal hooks are not silently claimed portable. Portable original image maps and actual geometric erosion remain; exact omitted hooks enumerated in report.

acceptance: One independent physical-lighting diagnostic only; neither native pixel equivalence nor photographic acceptance is claimed.

storageReview.reason: Earlier actual Scene01 unique export was approximately231MiB. This bounded diagnostic reduces the unique cap to384MiB, retains384MiB export floor and256MiB emergency floor. A1GiB start budget covers384MiB payload +384MiB retained +256MiB browser/JSON overhead. This is a smaller export allowance, not an unbounded relaxation. Export failure will not auto-retry or lift the cap.
